name: chess-quest
description: Wildcat Chess: a single-file chess game that teaches. Ten difficulty levels, a coach that names every mistake, spaced-repetition puzzles from the player's own blunders, themed for Woodland Springs Elementary.

scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/perft.js && node tests/contrast.test.js && QUICK=1 node tests/engine.test.js && node tests/browser.test.js
scripts.test:safari: ENGINE=webkit node tests/browser.test.js && ENGINE=webkit node tests/safari.test.js
scripts.test:all: npm run build && node tests/perft.js && node tests/contrast.test.js && node tests/engine.test.js && node tests/browser.test.js && ENGINE=chromium node tests/safari.test.js && node tests/repetition.test.js
